prompts.name: applications
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a 2 by 2 atlas containing four isolated 16:9 projection mapping application photographs for actual in-world monitor textures. Exactly four equal rectangular photographs fill a 2048x1152 landscape canvas, no margins or separators. TOP LEFT: an extravagant symmetrical Mughal palace facade at night, domed central gate and smaller side domes, exceptionally detailed blue and warm amber-gold projection mapping outlining stone arches and carving, black night sky. TOP RIGHT: an indoor live stage installation of monumental gothic archways and columns washed by intensely layered but credible blue and cyan projection mapping, axial perspective, dark atmosphere. BOTTOM LEFT: a product mapping installation in a dark art gallery, sculptural large geometric white cubes and angular luxury product objects covered in turquoise violet blue and gold projected light, small silhouettes for scale. BOTTOM RIGHT: an interactive gallery with three human visitors silhouetted within floor-to-ceiling flowing teal cyan projected botanical particles and responsive luminous trails, elegant charcoal walls. Premium cinematic photographic realism with dimensional material detail and rich black, not vector illustration. Each photo entirely fills its quadrant edge to edge; each independent composition fits a 16:9 crop. NO text, no labels, no lettering, no logo, no captions, no watermark, no physical television frame, no trade show booth.

prompts.name: hero
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: isolated 16:9 photographic projection mapping demonstration content for a physical monitor texture, no physical display frame. Primary request: a glorious symmetrical royal Mughal Indian palace model or palace facade with a large central onion dome and four smaller side domes, a tall ornate central pointed arch doorway and beautiful repeated side arches. At night every cornice, balustrade, dome rib and carved column is traced with warm champagne gold projection light and sapphire blue inner arch patterns, brilliant icy cyan and white diamond like filigree in the central portal. Extremely rich architectural depth and fine carvings, spectacular believable projected illumination, not a flat painted illustration. Black star speckled sky; building fills 92 percent canvas width and 86 percent height, broad frontal centered view, modest low horizon and a little black reflective ground. No people in front. Deep rich blacks, navy blue, cyan highlights and restrained golden amber, balanced highlights with visible carving and masonry. NO text, no lettering, no logo, no signage, no captions, no booth, no monitor surround, no photo border, no watermark. Output wide 2048x1152.

prompts.name: forest
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated 16:9 immersive projection content texture, to be shown on real vertical LED backdrop surfaces and circular overhead screens in a luxury projection mapping pavilion. An enchanted photoreal deep forest of immense dark rugged trunks and angular ancient slate rocks, densely textured emerald foliage, tiny teal and sapphire glowing dust points like constellations and fireflies, delicate warm gold liquid streaks drifting across leaves and branches, blue river reflections in the lower quarter. Starry luminous blue-green night with shafts of light between tree canopy, luxury cinematic natural materials, rich dimensional blacks and believable leaf textures. Composition: wide 2048x1152, forest fills entire frame; layered branches and gold flecks at upper edge, a subtle path and river toward middle distance; no identifiable central subject, detailed visual rhythm suitable for seamless-looking wrapping across ceiling panels. Color palette charcoal navy, muted emerald, sapphire blue, minute warm gold sparks; bright jewel colored highlights remain restrained. NO people, no palace, no buildings, no booth, no screen frames, no letters, no words, no branding, no logos, no captions, no watermarks. Full bleed isolated content only.
